scope: Final independent read-only review of the finite raw trigger recorder, shared JSON parser/serializer, ESP32-S3 diagnostic integration, HTTP request path, and auditor root coverage. No production source edits, child agents, connected hardware or flashing.
result: No remaining concrete blocker found in the reviewed recorder/JSON/target integration and exact audited ELF hashes. Initial architecture findings AR1-AR7 are resolved. This is source/native/static-build review, not physical timing or engine qualification. UI browser execution and the parent's in-progress HTTP/UI checks are outside this final approval scope.

resolved_findings.finding: Both-edge diagnostic capture originally shared and could overwrite decoder latches.
resolved_findings.final_review: Group0 capture channel configuration, on_capture and on_alarm are exact baseline source. A dedicated group1 capture timer/clock and separate two-edge channels isolate decoder latches. Diagnostic callback only maps/appends under the shared lock; it never queues decoder edges or changes executor state. Group1 channels are disabled outside finite recording windows. Physical dummy/legacy modes skip diagnostic allocation.

resolved_findings.finding: Rearm after final record read escaped stale-frame detection.
resolved_findings.final_review: frame_json now invokes a final current-frame predicate after copying/serializing rows, discards rows on mismatch and reports snapshot_superseded. Target also validates requested frame ID, returning HTTP409. Native regression explicitly rearms after final row read and passes.

resolved_findings.finding: Full512-row JSON could consume substantial heap and allocation failure could return partial unmarked data.
resolved_findings.final_review: GET defaults to metadata. Records are fixed64-row pages, query parser exposes no count override, and frame_json checks every creation/attachment. Target extra metadata is checked too. Failures delete partial trees and return null; send_json converts encode/null failure to HTTP500. Independent ASan/UBSan execution passed2000 allocation-budget positions through full page construction and encoding with zero live allocations afterward.

resolved_findings.finding: Pending old latches survived disable and invalid-time rows bypassed prearm filtering.
resolved_findings.final_review: Invalid/future mappings are dropped and counted; valid captured timestamps before frame start are dropped and counted. Before a new frame, task mutex serializes successful disable of both channels, a group1-only LL clear of capture0/1/2 status bits, frame start and enable. Worker acquires the same mutex nonblocking then re-reads state before disabling, preventing cleanup from stopping a newer frame. Existing in-flight callbacks are covered by timestamp validation; no target lock spans driver controls.

resolved_findings.finding: Public trigger JSON header included private firmware/main/config_json.hpp.
resolved_findings.final_review: Shared helpers moved to public ecu/json.hpp. Trigger and engine JSON now include it; main/config_json.hpp retains only profile parsing. Supplied selected and dummy builds link successfully without a broad main include path.

resolved_findings.finding: Nonexistent group_id field used on empty mcpwm_soft_sync_config_t.
resolved_findings.final_review: Removed field assignment; phase-on-sync binds source to group1 capture timer. Pinned IDF API source matches this use.

resolved_findings.finding: ISR audit omitted new diagnostic callback root.
resolved_findings.final_review: Root discovery includes on_trigger_capture. Independently rerun audits found5 roots/30 functions for selected image and4 roots/29 functions for dummy, with the diagnostic callback absent from dummy. All audited code/literal fetches stay in IRAM/ROM, checked dispatcher data in DRAM,63 SDK assertion argument-only pointers reviewed and0 unclassified flash pointers.

baseline_contract_checks.selected_output_policy: ECU_ENGINE_DUMMY_LOADS remains disabled in selected environment; OutputIO high writes are compiled out and app retains all_off. Diagnostic operations cannot enable physical outputs.
baseline_contract_checks.dummy_diagnostic_exclusion: Actual dummy ELF has no on_trigger_capture, trigger_clock or init_trigger_logger symbols; reviewed source compile guard also skips legacy pulse mode.
baseline_contract_checks.isr_cam_context: Independently inspected symbol table: selected cam_context at0x3fca5318,dummy at0x3fc9acbc, both internal initialized data.
baseline_contract_checks.driver_callback_mapping: GPTimer callback registration maps to on_alarm; group0 MCPWM maps to on_capture; selected group1 maps to on_trigger_capture. Remaining driver callback indirections are these explicitly reviewed registrations.

validation.independent_native: Fresh reviewer builds in .cache/engine/trigger-review with -std=c++17 -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -fsanitize=address,undefined. Both trigger_log_test and trigger_log_json_test pass. cJSON C source is also sanitizer-built. Log: final-recorder-native.log.
validation.builds: Reviewed parent trigger-build-current.log: selected and dummy builds successful. Independently hashed actual ELF files and reran static auditor on each exact image.
validation.broader_regressions: Reviewed parent trigger-native-final.log and trigger-existing-python.log; native controller/storage/timing tests pass and existing54 Python tests pass. These broad tests were not unnecessarily rerun by this reviewer.
validation.ui_scope: Read static page-assembly behavior: UI gathers a frozen same-ID frame, validates each64-row page and checks final metadata. Browser rendering/asynchronous UI tests remain owned by parent and are not claimed as independently executed here.

remaining_hardware_limits: No physical ESP32 execution. ISR duration, lock hold time, cross-core latency, capture age and timer jitter remain unmeasured.

Group1 isolates decoder capture registers but still has one last-capture latch per channel. SDK reads timestamp and polarity separately. Lost/coalesced captures, overwrite and mixed timestamp/polarity pairs remain possible and unmeasured.
Finite storage bounds memory, not diagnostic interrupt rate or worker time-to-disable under arbitrary electrical noise. Diagnostic allocation is excluded from physical modes.
Sync bracket uncertainty and32-bit counter wrap behavior need independent hardware stimulus/timestamp validation. Logical invalid/prearm handling is source/native verified only.
SDK assertion paths are reviewed for cache-safe metadata handling; this review does not establish physical fail-low behavior during an SDK panic/assertion.

Recorded edges describe conditioned digital inputs, not analog sensor waveform voltage, per-pin actuator measurements or720-degree cam phase. No complete Speeduino/TunerStudio high-speed-logger interoperability claim follows.
